context.roleEssence: This role leads a small Solutions Engineering team that supports Veridian's sales motion in the pre-sales stage - running technical discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts that convert enterprise pipeline into bookings. As manager, the job is less about personally running deals and more about coaching the three engineers on the team, owning their operating rhythm, and being accountable for how well SE work moves deals through the sales cycle. Expertise here means deep fluency in Veridian's product suite (especially Knowledge Hub, AI Assistant, and Governance, since those are what get demoed and scrutinized by enterprise buyers) plus the people-management skill of developing engineers who each own their own accounts and deals.

onboardingNeeds.title: One-on-ones with each of your Solutions Engineers
onboardingNeeds.purpose: Understand each engineer's current deals, strengths, and what support they need from you as their new manager.
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence establishes that managing and coaching this team's three engineers is the core, ongoing work of the role, not an introductory nicety - these meetings are the hands-on job itself.

onboardingNeeds.title: Coaching and technical-manager frameworks for supporting SEs on live deals
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Exists because of the one-on-one relationships above - prepares for giving useful deal coaching and technical guidance in those ongoing conversations rather than generic management advice.

onboardingNeeds.title: Shadow a live customer demo or POC in progress
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence identifies technical discovery/demos/POCs as the core SE motion this manager must be credible in - observing a real one grounds later coaching in how the work actually happens here, not just in theory.

onboardingNeeds.title: Deep dive on Knowledge Hub, AI Assistant, and Governance for demo scenarios
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence ties expertise directly to product fluency for enterprise buyer conversations - these are the GA products most central to what the team demos and defends technically.

onboardingNeeds.title: Meet your manager, Michael Bennett, and align on Sales/SE operating rhythm
onboardingNeeds.purpose: Align on how Solutions Engineering's rhythm connects to broader Sales targets and reporting expectations.
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Standard but necessary manager relationship - not part of the role's defining work, but needed to operate within the Sales department structure.

onboardingNeeds.title: Meet an Account Executive you'll partner with on deals
onboardingNeeds.purpose: Understand how SE and AE roles split responsibility across a typical deal cycle.
onboardingNeeds.rationale: SE work is inherently paired with AE-led deals; understanding that handoff is useful context but is a peer interface, not the manager's own defining relationship.
